description: Yearly crude fatal (KA) shares, shares standardised to the pooled 2016-24 covariate distribution (models A, B with year), and composition-only expected shares under the 2016-19 model
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
outcome: fatal, ka (NHTSA-imputed severity, primary); fatal_cc (complete-case sensitivity; see column 'outcome')
method: Survey-weighted (pseudo-ML) logistic models, ridge 0.01; predictive margins; Taylor linearisation with coefficient influence, summed within 67 PSUs / 25 strata; t with 42 df

labels.expectedA_*, expectedB_*: hypothetical (2016-19 model applied to each year's crashes: composition-only expectation)

rr_vs_2016_19: ratio to the unweighted mean of the 2016-2019 yearly values
